_comment: Everything the station says. Edit here, not in the code.
WHO'S TALKING
jax / silo — the two idiots running the station. THEY DO NOT KNOW
ANYONE FROM XCOM IS LISTENING. You've tuned into their
frequency; they're just doing their show. So they never address
the Commander, never say 'sir', never acknowledge the app or the
game, and never break character. They talk to each other and to
whatever ragged audience they imagine is out there. Unhinged,
over-caffeinated, running on stolen equipment and spite.
shen — Lily Shen, monitoring the frequency from the Avenger. She DOES
know you're listening and addresses you directly. Hers is the
only voice that mentions the app, settings, updates or faults.
When something is actually wrong, she says so.
The split is by JOB as well as voice — jax is on the decks (tracks,
playlists), silo is on the wire (incoming, the outside world) — so the log
still tells you what happened underneath the patter.
Placeholders like {state} carry raw values such as state_mission_combat.
Keep them in: they're the actual information, and someone diagnosing a
problem needs them. The patter goes AROUND them.
WRITING A LINE
text     the line. {braces} are filled in by the caller.
variants optional list; one is picked at random each time. Use for
anything said often — a station that says the identical thing
forty times an evening stops sounding like a station.
ALL variants of a line must use the SAME {placeholders}, so
which one gets picked can never change what the caller has to
supply. There's a test for this.
Any {placeholder} must match what the call site passes. A missing one
won't crash — see src/dialogue.py — but it will print the raw brace, so
check the key in the code before renaming one.
Read by src/dialogue.py, bundled into the build by the .spec file.

shen.name: SHEN
shen.role: monitoring the frequency — knows you're listening

jax.name: JAX
jax.role: on the decks — does not know you exist

silo.name: SILO
silo.role: on the wire — does not know you exist

boot.online.speaker: shen
boot.online.text: You're on their frequency, Commander. Try not to let Central hear it.

engine.rescan_done.speaker: shen
engine.rescan_done.text: Rescan complete. Every track present and correct.

update.staged.speaker: shen
update.staged.text: Update ready. Your current version is kept in {backup}. Restarting.

update.backup_kept.speaker: shen
update.backup_kept.text: Previous version kept: {what}. It's in a _previous_v folder beside the app, with a note inside on how to go back. Delete it whenever you want the space.

update.half_applied.speaker: shen
update.half_applied.text: This install looks half-updated: the app says {running}, the build beside it says {recorded}. Re-run the update, or unzip a fresh copy over this folder.

flag.missing.speaker: shen
flag.missing.text: {flag} is MISSING from your Alternative Mod Launcher arguments!

flag.missing_detail.speaker: shen
flag.missing_detail.text: Music will play straight over your cinematics until it's back. Run setup and press the button, or add it under Options > Settings > Active arguments.

flag.added.speaker: shen
flag.added.text: Added {flag} to the Alternative Mod Launcher's arguments.

flag.already_set.speaker: shen
flag.already_set.text: Alternative Mod Launcher already has {flag}. Nothing to do.

engine.switching.speaker: jax
variants: Right — killing {old}, bringing up {new}. {count} in the crate.
That's {old} done. {new} next, and I've got {count} lined up.
SILO, cut {old}. We're going to {new}. {count} ready.
Off {old}, onto {new}. {count} tracks. Don't touch anything.

engine.game_has_it.speaker: jax
variants: Nothing in {state}. Dead air — put the house tape on.
{state}'s empty. SILO, we've got nothing. Play literally anything.
No tape for {state}. Letting the old broadcast bleed through.

engine.standing_down.speaker: jax
engine.standing_down.text: Faders down on {state}. Not our shift.

engine.dead_air.speaker: jax
engine.dead_air.text: Dead air. SILO. SILO. Is the aerial still on the roof.

engine.stinger_done.speaker: jax
engine.stinger_done.text: And that's the sting on {state}. Beautiful. Nobody heard it.

engine.radio_mix.speaker: jax
engine.radio_mix.text: Mixing {pools} — swapping between them so it doesn't get stale.

radio.on.speaker: jax
radio.on.text: WE ARE LIVE. Anarchy FM, broadcasting from a van that is definitely on fire.

radio.off.speaker: jax
radio.off.text: Off air. Back to the regular tapes.

radio.restored.speaker: jax
radio.restored.text: Picking up where we left off. Nobody noticed we stopped.

boot.game_already_running.speaker: silo
boot.game_already_running.text: Signal's already up. We're broadcasting into something in progress. Bold.

spotify.handoff.speaker: silo
spotify.handoff.text: Patching {state} through to the streaming lot. Their tower, their problem.

game.closed_pausing.speaker: silo
game.closed_pausing.text: Signal's dropped. Holding the broadcast. JAX, stop touching things.

game.signed_off.speaker: silo
game.signed_off.text: Carrier's gone. Killing the transmitter before ADVENT triangulates us. Again.

update.checking.speaker: silo
update.checking.text: Sweeping the band for a newer signal — we're on {version}.

update.up_to_date.speaker: silo
update.up_to_date.text: Nothing newer out there. {version} is as good as it gets.

update.available.speaker: silo
update.available.text: Picking up a newer broadcast: {new}. We're running {current}.

update.verified.speaker: silo
update.verified.text: Signal's clean — {count} files, version {version}. No jamming.

boot.waiting_for_launch.speaker: silo
variants: No carrier yet. We're just talking to ourselves out here. Hit the button when you're ready.
Transmitting into an empty band. Someone start the game, we're getting bored.
Nothing on the frequency yet. JAX, play something while we wait.
